name: ElevenLabs official Skills
licensing_note: MIT Skill code; hosted services/voices separate
limits_and_status: Ten Skills in inspected README. Python elevenlabs; JS @elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js. No need live conversational agent Skills for prerecorded lessons.

name: ElevenLabs MCP
limits_and_status: MCP is tool access, not TTS quality or permission sandbox. Prefer SDK worker for bulk production.

name: Eleven v4
limits_and_status: Released 28 Sep 2026. v4 and turbo differ. v4 no SSML or legacy speed/style sliders. Text-to-dialogue documented; endpoint feature parity must be tested.

name: Eleven pronunciation
decision: Audited model-specific dictionary, aliases as portable base
limits_and_status: Dictionary phonemes are not universal SSML support. Newer API docs and Studio guides differ; pin exact endpoint/model/dictionary version.

name: Eleven forced alignment
limits_and_status: Aligns supplied text and audio; not an independent scientific/pronunciation test.

name: Cartesia official Skills
decision: cartesia-api; not line-voice-agent for recorded lessons
limits_and_status: Use selected instructions only. Installation does not create a licensed voice or guarantee provider contract compatibility.

name: Cartesia MCP
licensing_note: Check pinned repository licence and service terms
limits_and_status: Do not add production orchestration merely to wrap a REST request.

name: Cartesia Sonic
limits_and_status: Sonic3.6 appears on current product pages; checked API documentation snapshot was 3.5. Scaffold pins 3.5-2026-05-04, not a claim that 3.5 is latest. Assamese not established by this audit.

name: Gemini TTS
licensing_note: Commercial API terms; free/paid data policies differ
decision: 3.8 Flash expressive challenger; Flash-Lite high-throughput comparison
limits_and_status: Latest indexed guide: structured speech_metadata, verbatim text, angle-bracket event tags, unary WAV. Old cached guide still showed3.1. Assamese documented in current language list; native audition mandatory.

name: OpenAI speech
decision: Evaluate realtime2.1-mini migration; do not launch on legacy TTS
limits_and_status: Official deprecation notice dated2026-10-01 schedules the old TTS snapshots for shutdown2027-01-06. Replacement is gpt-realtime-2.1-mini. Old recipe is an OFFLINE MIGRATION FIXTURE blocked for production. Realtime replacement requires a new live-tested adapter; it is not assumed a drop-in endpoint. Assamese not admitted by scaffold.

name: OpenAI curated speech Skill
limits_and_status: Not proof current commands/model defaults are ideal for ExamLeaf. Model/endpoint contracts override old Skill snippets.

name: Remotion Skills
licensing_note: Skills and renderer/service licensing are separate
limits_and_status: Remotion composes media; it is not a voice model. Drive <Sequence> and <Audio> from measured global timeline. No Remotion runtime tested in this package.

name: Anthropic Skills
licensing_note: Many Apache2; document Skills source-available separately
decision: skill-creator for evaluations; webapp-testing for reviewer UI
limits_and_status: No inherited assertion that a Skill is production-safe. Review scripts and allowed tools.

name: Manim Voiceover
limits_and_status: Use preapproved clips and bookmarks. Do not synthesize again inside every render. Not needed for the native timing proof.

name: Chatterbox
licensing_note: MIT as published; reference voice rights separate
limits_and_status: Multilingual model documents Hindi. Turbo/Nano language coverage differs; not all variants multilingual. Assamese not established. No local inference benchmark.

name: Kokoro82M
decision: Economical English drafts and listening challenger
limits_and_status: Small82M model. Do not assume same expressive controls as premium systems. No Assamese support established. Voice/language table required before non-English production.

name: Fish Speech S2
licensing_note: FISH AUDIO RESEARCH LICENSE for code and weights
decision: Research candidate; not default commercial self-hosting
limits_and_status: Open repository is not an unrestricted commercial licence. Obtain suitable commercial authorization or provider contract.

name: F5-TTS
licensing_note: MIT code; default pretrained weights CC-BY-NC
decision: Research only with default weights for this commercial project
limits_and_status: Do not infer commercial permission from code licence. Replacement checkpoints need their own provenance/terms.

name: CosyVoice
limits_and_status: FunAudioLLM URL redirects. Current listed9 languages omit Hindi/Assamese. Do not label it Indic-ready from general multilingual claims.

name: Qwen3-TTS
licensing_note: Apache2 code/weights as published; voice rights separate
limits_and_status: Documented language list does not establish Hindi/Assamese. No target-hardware or STEM audition performed.

name: Indic Parler TTS
licensing_note: Apache2 model metadata; gated download consent
limits_and_status: Explicit Assamese and emotion-prompt documentation. Native review required. Newer Indic-Speak mention does not carry old model licence forward.

name: WhisperX
decision: English alignment candidate with validated locale models
limits_and_status: Number/currency tokens can lack times; language-specific aligner needed; overlapping speech weak. Do not run diarization for a single narrator by default.

name: faster-whisper
licensing_note: MIT runtime; model files separately reviewed
limits_and_status: Use audio-only decoding; do not supply expected answer text that biases away defects. Not installed here.

name: Montreal Forced Aligner
licensing_note: MIT code; acoustic/lexicon model licences separate
decision: Offline phoneme alignment for supported language resources
limits_and_status: Need matching phoneme dictionary and acoustic model, including STEM entries. Not a pronunciation oracle.

name: Silero VAD
licensing_note: MIT as published; verify pinned assets
limits_and_status: Never remove protected think/write pauses automatically. Not installed here.

name: FFmpeg
decision: Required decode, loudnorm, mux and final remeasurement
limits_and_status: Two-pass loudness and sample-rate output executed on synthetic signal fixtures here. No speech-quality claim.

name: SoundFile + SciPy
limits_and_status: Installed environment used. Local normalized timeline and exact zeros demonstrated. No implicit denoising.

name: librosa
limits_and_status: Pitch statistics and neural MOS are diagnostics, not grades for teaching/naturalness. Not installed for this package.
